business_summary: Shan Xi Hua Yang Group New Energy Co.,Ltd., a mining company, engages in the production, washing, processing, and sale of coal in China. The company was formerly known as Yangquan Coal Industry (Group) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shan Xi Hua Yang Group New Energy Co.,Ltd. in January 2021. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Yangquan, China. Shan Xi Hua Yang Group New Energy Co.,Ltd. is an operating subsidiary of Huayang New Materials Group.
business_summary_ko: 광산 회사인 Shan Xi Hua Yang Group New Energy Co.,Ltd.는 중국에서 석탄의 생산, 세척, 가공 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 이전에 Yangquan Coal Industry (Group) Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 이름을 Shan Xi Hua Yang Group New Energy Co., Ltd.로 변경했습니다. 2021년 1월. 이 회사는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 양취안에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Shan Xi Hua Yang Group New Energy Co.,Ltd. 화양신소재그룹의 운영 자회사입니다.
